correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of F=Y^2 Z-X^3-X^2 Z over F_7 gives singular locus X=Y=0. In the Z-chart of the origin blow-up the strict transform is B^2-A^3-A^2=0 with the blow-up coordinate free, so A=B=0 is a singular line; the X- and Y-chart equations have no simultaneous zero of equation and gradient. Hence the one-step origin blow-up is not smooth. The homogeneous scaling homotopy contracts the affine cone to its vertex, so A^1-invariance of KH gives KH_{-1}(S)=KH_{-1}(F_7)=0. The claimed exact K_{-1}(S) is explicitly left open.
